method_selection.citation: standard hyperparameter search practice (random/grid search, Bergstra & Bengio JMLR 2012); package composition per DCNv2/BPR training setups.
method_selection.why: Validation peaks near epoch 8 and then declines while training loss continues falling, indicating overfit. This untried card jointly tunes the literature-backed capacity, regularization, objective, recency, and half-epoch checkpoint package rather than repeating the already-tried stage matrix or a failed fixed regularization bundle. Its measured target near 0.6047 implies an honest gain of about +0.0020 over the prior run's 0.602732 winner and +0.0029 over the current 0.6018 baseline, enough to plausibly clear epsilon. Use the mandated wide random stage with at least 20 candidates, successive halving followed by full-fidelity survivor evaluation, then local refinement and matched-seed confirmation.

rejected.reason: Already used in run_deep_l2; repeating it would not isolate or reproduce the winning configuration and violates the preference against retrying the same direction.
The fixed compound regularization opening already regressed to 0.598169, and this card is running elsewhere; dial interactions should instead be searched inside the complete package.
Premature with 15 iterations left and no replicated single-model champion; ensembling should follow package tuning and attribution.
Unavailable because it is measured-dead at 0.6022 and failed confirmation; the requested censored-watch-time attribution cannot justify selecting this implementation again.
